reading: A set of 16 generations loops if at least 5 hit the cap stuck in a loop, is clean with at most 2, and is unclear in between. Both clean: the 25% sparsity causes the loops (next: a bigger expert budget or full expert training). Unhealed clean, healed looping: the healing causes them (next: on-policy distillation from the 9B). Unhealed looping: the low-rank DeltaNet cut or the 64K vocabulary does.

predictions.reproduce: With rebuilt low-rank factors and the saved adapter, the learned-router student reproduces the healing run's last milestone: KL within 0.01 of 0.612 and 64K bits per byte within 1% of 0.734.
predictions.all_reproduce: With every neuron, the healed student reproduces the first probe: KL within 0.01 of 0.242.
predictions.unhealed_kl: Without the adapter, every neuron running drifts less than with it (0.242): the adapter, trained with 25% of the neurons, overshoots when all of them run. Before healing the low-rank DeltaNet cut alone cost 0.156.
predictions.loops_unhealed: Without the adapter, at most 2 of the 16 generations loop (dense: 0; dense with int8 state, KL 0.083: 1).
predictions.loops_healed: With the adapter and every neuron, at least 3 of the 16 loop: the healing is at least part of the cause.
predictions.short_answers: The healed student's finished answers stay short with every neuron (median under 600 tokens; at 25% they ran 108-531, the dense model's 647-1,588), and the unhealed student's do not.
